definitions.explanation: A soft, light wind. Conveys a pleasant, mild sensation.

examples.japanese: {微風|そよかぜ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{吹|ふ}いている→吹く：02445_fuku⟧。
⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{微風|そよかぜ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{頬|ほお}→頬：03717_hoo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{心地|ここち}よい→心地よい：12515_kokochiyoi⟧。
examples.english: The spring breeze feels pleasant on my cheeks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{木々|きぎ}→木々：04811_kigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{葉|は}→葉：02241_ha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{微風|そよかぜ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}れて→揺れる：01161_yureru⟧、⟦さらさら→さらさら：05255_sarasara⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てていた→立てる：01196_tateru⟧。
examples.english: The leaves of the trees swayed in the gentle breeze, making a rustling sound.

notes:
KANJI: Written as {微風|そよかぜ} or そよ{風|かぜ}. The kanji {微風|びふう} can also be read びふう in a more formal/technical context.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {微風|そよかぜ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{吹|ふ}く→吹く：02445_fuku⟧: a gentle breeze blows
- {微風|そよかぜ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}れる→揺れる：01161_yureru⟧: to sway in the breeze
- ⟦{心地|ここち}よい→心地よい：12515_kokochiyoi⟧{微風|そよかぜ}: a pleasant breeze

USAGE: A mild, poetic word often used in descriptions of pleasant weather, especially in spring and early summer. Contrasts with stronger wind words like ⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧ (wind) and ⟦{突風|とっぷう}→突風：15921_toppuu⟧ (gust).
